description: This Java class implements a pipeline function named 'filter' related to RQL filtering operations within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It provides methods to apply filter functions based on parameters like filter value, RQL function, and compared value, and defines the function's signature and parameter descriptions.

classes.name: PipelineFunctionFilter
classes.description: Provides the implementation for the filter function within a data processing pipeline, including signature definition and parameter handling.

classes.name: PipelineFunctionFilter.FilterFunctionSignature
classes.description: Defines the signature for the filter function, including its parameters.

classes.name: PipelineFunctionFilter.FilterValueParam
classes.description: Parameter class describing the filter value parameter.

classes.name: PipelineFunctionFilter.RqlFunctionParam
classes.description: Parameter class describing the RQL function parameter.

classes.name: PipelineFunctionFilter.ComparedValueParam
classes.description: Parameter class describing the compared value parameter.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the function, which is 'filter'.

methods.name: getSignature
methods.description: Returns the signature of the filter function defining its parameters.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies the filter function to a PipelineElement based on parameters and expression resolver, filtering data conditionally.

methods.name: parseAndResolve
methods.description: Parses and resolves the parameters for the filter function from the string input.
